attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Massachusetts state income tax. Flat 5.00% rate (MA Gen. Laws ch. 62, § 4, 2025) on AGI minus the filing-status personal exemption. Personal exemption: $4,400 Single/MFS, $8,800 MFJ, $6,800 HOH. Plus a 4% surtax (Fair Share Amendment) on AGI above the surtax threshold ($1,083,150 in 2025). Writes result.ma_taxable_income, result.ma_state_tax, result.ma_surtax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.ma_state_tax = 0; set result.ma_taxable_income = 0; set result.ma_surtax = 0; add " Massachusetts Tax Calculation (Form 1) - flat 5.00% + 4% surtax over $1,083,150" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.ma_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.ma_taxable_income xdef 0 cvd /result.ma_surtax xdef " Massachusetts Tax Calculation (Form 1) - flat 5.00% + 4% surtax over $1,083,150" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_comment: Form 1-NR/PY line 4a 8,800 married filing jointly / qualifying surviving spouse exemption plus line 4b $1,000 per dependent claimed on the U.S. return (every dependent on the return); line 22 multiplies the total (22a) by the ratio; line 23 = max(21 - 22, 0); line 26 = 5.0% of line 23 (2025 Form 1-NR/PY)
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ma_total_exemptions = 8800.0 + result.ma_exemption_dependent * (double) (length of job.dependents); set result.ma_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.ma_total_exemptions * result.ma_exemption_ratio) and 0.0; set result.ma_state_tax = result.ma_taxable_income * 0.05; add " MA exemptions (line 4g): $8,800 married filing jointly / qualifying surviving spouse + " + (length of job.dependents) + " dependents x $1,000 = $" + result.ma_total_exemptions + "; line 22: x " + result.ma_exemption_ratio + " = $" + (result.ma_total_exemptions * result.ma_exemption_ratio) + "; 5.0% income after exemptions (line 23): $" + result.ma_taxable_income to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: 8800.0 result.ma_exemption_dependent job.dependents length cvd fmul f+ cvd /result.ma_total_exemptions xdef result.state_calc_agi result.ma_total_exemptions result.ma_exemption_ratio fmul f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ma_taxable_income xdef result.ma_taxable_income 0.05 fmul cvd /result.ma_state_tax xdef " MA exemptions (line 4g): $8,800 married filing jointly / qualifying surviving spouse + " job.dependents length strconcat " dependents x $1,000 = $" strconcat result.ma_total_exemptions strconcat "; line 22: x " strconcat result.ma_exemption_ratio strconcat " = $" strconcat result.ma_total_exemptions result.ma_exemption_ratio fmul strconcat "; 5.0% income after exemptions (line 23): $" strconcat result.ma_taxable_income strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Massachusetts military retirement income exclusion. Skeleton — see issue #446. 100% exclusion for military retirement pay + SBP, MSRRA / SCRA compliant. Per MA Gen. Laws ch. 62, § 2 (2025).

condition_details.condition_comment: The roster entry being computed is a non-resident of Massachusetts. Form 1-NR/PY line 22: nonresidents multiply line 22a by line 14g (income ratio); part-year residents multiply by line 3 (days as a resident, column 2); a full-year resident takes the whole exemption (column 3)
A part-year resident entry: Form 1-NR/PY lines 2 and 3 prorate the exemption by days of residence, not by income

action_details.action_comment: 2025 Form 1-NR/PY line 14g: divide line 14d (Massachusetts-source income) by line 14f (total income this return = 14d + 14e), carried to four decimal places. 14e is non-Massachusetts income, not less than 0 (form), from total U.S. income before adjustments (Form 1040 line 9) less what Massachusetts does not tax; Social Security and state tax refunds are the exclusions the engine models (see result.ma_non_ma_income). The Social Security term subtracts the whole benefit because the federal pass (Calculate_SS_Taxability) includes the whole benefit in gross_income; when the federal pass is corrected, subtract result.taxable_social_security instead -- scenario MultiState_19 holds the Massachusetts figure ($1,423.26) either way and will say so. Not federal AGI: the review of #1328 showed a $7,000 IRA deduction moving the ratio from 0.25 to 0.2655 when AGI was the denominator. The cap at 1.0 follows from 14e >= 0
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ma_non_ma_income = the maximum of (result.gross_income - result.total_social_security - result.state_tax_refund - result.state_calc_agi) and 0.0; set result.ma_total_income = result.state_calc_agi + result.ma_non_ma_income; set result.ma_exemption_ratio = (result.state_calc_agi / result.ma_total_income) rounded to 4 decimal places; add " MA deduction and exemption ratio (Form 1-NR/PY line 14g): Massachusetts income $" + result.state_calc_agi + " (14d) / total income this return $" + result.ma_total_income + " (14f = 14d + non-Massachusetts income $" + result.ma_non_ma_income + " (14e)) = " + result.ma_exemption_ratio to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.gross_income result.total_social_security f- result.state_tax_refund f- result.state_calc_agi f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ma_non_ma_income xdef result.state_calc_agi result.ma_non_ma_income f+ cvd /result.ma_total_income xdef result.state_calc_agi result.ma_total_income fdiv 4 0.5 roundto cvd /result.ma_exemption_ratio xdef " MA deduction and exemption ratio (Form 1-NR/PY line 14g): Massachusetts income $" result.state_calc_agi strconcat " (14d) / total income this return $" strconcat result.ma_total_income strconcat " (14f = 14d + non-Massachusetts income $" strconcat result.ma_non_ma_income strconcat " (14e)) = " strconcat result.ma_exemption_ratio strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: A full-year resident takes the whole exemption (Form 1, line 22 has no ratio)

Line 3: total days as a Massachusetts resident divided by 365, carried to four decimal places (2025 Form 1-NR/PY instructions, Lines 2 and 3). The days come from the roster entry period (state_tax_result.days_in_state, both ends counted), published as result.state_calc_days_in_state
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ma_exemption_ratio = ((double) result.state_calc_days_in_state / 365.0) rounded to 4 decimal places; add " MA exemption ratio (Form 1-NR/PY line 3): " + result.state_calc_days_in_state + " days resident / 365 = " + result.ma_exemption_ratio to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_days_in_state cvd 365.0 fdiv 4 0.5 roundto cvd /result.ma_exemption_ratio xdef " MA exemption ratio (Form 1-NR/PY line 3): " result.state_calc_days_in_state strconcat " days resident / 365 = " strconcat result.ma_exemption_ratio strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
